summary: M3 UI/UX redesign verification on 390x844. All 6 acceptance criteria PASS: (1) AuthPage renders with M3 warm surface, pill-shaped Login/Sign Up tab switcher, and gradient login button (linear-gradient 135deg #D6336C → #E8590C, border-radius 9999px). (2) After login, Discover shows full-screen profile card (Rahul Kumar, 25) with action buttons (Pass/SuperLike/Like) visible above the M3 navbar — action-buttons bottom=756px vs viewport 844px, navbar height=61px, gap=27px. (3) All 5 nav tabs (Discover, Likes, Alerts/Notifications, Chats/Matches, Profile) navigate without errors; each page renders headings and content; navbar remains pinned to viewport bottom. Active tab shows the M3 indicator pill (bg rgb(255,217,226) = --m3-primary-container, border-radius 9999px) — verified only the active tab has the pill (inactive tabs have no pill), which matches the M3 spec. (4) ProfilePage: gradient header card with avatar, name 'HeartLink Reviewer', email, Online Now chip, Verified badge, and Activity Stats card grid — all styled with M3 surface treatment. (5) MatchesPage: three segmented tabs 'Matches (0) / Messages / Active (0)' with the active tab filled --m3-primary-container pink. (6) Like and Pass buttons on Discover are clickable and advance the profile correctly. M3 CSS tokens are loaded on :root: --m3-primary=#D6336C, --m3-surface=#FFFBFF, --m3-surface-container-low=#FFF0F3, --m3-shape-xl=28px. --nav-total=61px matches actual navbar height. No JS runtime errors on any page.

issues: Individual segment buttons have border-radius 0px. M3 segmented buttons typically have rounded outer container with the outer-most segments rounded on their outer edge. Visually acceptable inside the tinted group but not strictly M3-compliant.

No aria-current / aria-selected / data-active attribute on nav-* buttons — active state only communicated by the presence of the indicator pill (visual only). Consider adding aria-current='page' for accessibility.

action_items: MINOR (pre-existing from iter 24): Console error still emits — 'Received true for a non-boolean attribute jsx' — some component leaks the styled-jsx `jsx` prop to the DOM. Non-blocking but should be located and cleaned up.
MINOR: Add aria-current='page' (or data-active) on the active [data-testid^='nav-'] button so screen readers / tests can detect active state without relying on the pill visual.
critical_code_review_comments: M3 CSS uses --m3-* prefix (not the standard MD3 --md-sys-color-*). Consistent within the app but non-standard — future contributors may be confused. Consider aliasing.
MatchesPage segmented tab buttons have border-radius:0 individually — for true M3 segmented buttons the outer button in the group should have rounded outer corners.
TopBar is not queryable via [data-testid='top-bar']/<header>/class*='TopBar' — consider adding data-testid='top-bar' for easier automated testing (visual render is fine).
